trello_cards.description:

**Focus:** Gaming-only fund — exclusively invests in games ecosystem
**Fund Size:** $80M Fund III (2019); $12.8B+ value created from prior funds
**Check Size:** Seed: $500K-$3M

**Location:** London, UK
**Website:** https://londonvp.com

## Primary Contact
| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Name | David Gardner OBE |
| Title | Co-Founder & General Partner |
| Background | 30+ years gaming; Former CEO, Atari; EVP/COO EA Worldwide Studios; 25 years at EA — built EA Europe from 0 to $1B+ revenue |
| LinkedIn | https://uk.linkedin.com/in/david-gardner-7395662 |

## Other Partners
